title: UPSC IES / ISS Result 2026
postName: Indian Economic Service (IES) / Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026
vacancyDetails: Result of UPSC Indian Economic Service and Indian Statistical Service Examination 2026 (written / final as published)
qualification: Post Graduate degree in Economics / Statistics or as per IES-ISS notification
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years as on relevant date (relaxations as per UPSC rules)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Interview / Personality Test → Final Result
documentsRequired: Roll number; educational certificates, category certificate, photo ID for interview stage
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open Written Results or Final Results
3. Download IES / ISS Result 2026 PDF
4. Search roll number in the list
5. Follow interview / joining instructions if shortlisted
shortDescription: UPSC IES ISS Result 2026 released. Check recommended candidates list at upsc.gov.in.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published the Indian Economic Service (IES) / Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Result 2026.

Candidates who appeared in the examination can download the official PDF listing roll numbers qualified for interview or finally recommended, depending on the stage of result published.

Services covered

  • IES – Indian Economic Service
  • ISS – Indian Statistical Service

Always use upsc.gov.in for authentic result PDFs and next-stage notices.
